caption_pattern = Center figure (distracted): The person, group, or entity getting distracted — label with whoever or whatever is doing the abandoning. Right figure (neglected girlfriend): The existing commitment, tool, or responsibility being ignored — what they should be paying attention to. Left figure (new temptation): The exciting, shiny alternative that is pulling focus away.

Often funnier or more honest than the rejected option.
